formula: u=d-2**(n-1); w=floor(2**64 * u / 2**(n-1)); chain n=75,80,...,130; w_{n+5}≡a*w_n+c (mod 2**64); infer a,c from w75,w80,w85 only; exact holdout 90..130; no width/modulus/byte-reverse/approx
domains: solved d in band; w in 0..2**64-1
score_definition: exact match count on holdout n=90..130; promote only if 9/9
trivial_exclusion_justification: Tests creator-side payload recurrence on known d; not ECDSA verification or curve membership.
